title: Had a stressful travel dream in one of my usual vehicles & airports, but it was…my husband’s dream?
content: This is kinda funny to me, we’ve been having shared dreams this year for some random reason. He has some travel coming up that he is really stressed about, so I know why I had the dream, but I’ve never straight up had a dream from someone else’s point of view before! The vehicle we were driving in to the airport was a crowded van, almost like a moving van, with tiny back windows and straps hanging by them. I was trying to navigate layovers and trying to download the uber app & get an Uber (my husband lol) and make calls, but of course the phone doesn’t work. I’m panicking because I realize I don’t have any money in my account (ME lol). This made me realize I think the only clean places in my dreams are airports and water parks.
